name: Affine Transformation & Base-3 Tie-Breaker Obfuscation
description: Replaces the matrix invertibility condition with modular affine transformations that only form the identity when opposite bases are applied, preserving the 2-coloring reduction. Rephrases the 'lexicographically smallest' tie-breaker as 'minimizing the sequence as a base-3 integer'. Models that fail to recognize the equivalence will attempt to construct and compare 200,000-digit integers, leading to TLE or Python's integer string conversion limit RTE, while models that reason algorithmically will correctly use greedy BFS.
